name: HashiCorp Nomad
description: Shows a Nomad cluster as hosts and guests: the client nodes as hosts with their address, state and eligibility, and the allocations (running tasks of your jobs) as guests of the node they run on, with namespace, job, image, published ports, restarts and start time. Read-only: it only reads nodes and allocations, with an ACL token that has the read-job and node read capabilities if your cluster uses ACLs.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
